# Kesari — The Memory Studio: Complete Reference & Knowledge Base

## Overview
Kesari — The Memory Studio is an independent cultural venue, acoustic chamber, live music stage, pro audio equipment rental house, and pure vegetarian artisan cafe located in Koramangala 4th Block, Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Contact & Location
- Address: Koramangala 4th Block, Bangalore, Karnataka 560034, India
- Phone: +91 77605 39955
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917760539955
- Email: booking@kesaristudio.com / events@kesaristudio.com
- Hours: 10:00 AM – 11:30 PM IST Daily
- Sound Curfew: Amplified live bands until 10:30 PM; acoustic & cafe sets until 11:30 PM.

## Venue Rules & Values
1. **100% Pure Vegetarian**: All food served on-site is strictly vegetarian. Vegan, Jain, and Satvik options are prepared on request.
2. **Alcohol-Free Sanctuary**: Outside alcohol is strictly prohibited to maintain an intimate listening room atmosphere.
3. **Acoustic Precision**: All spaces are calibrated for sound isolation with treated hardwood, acoustic baffling, and calibrated front-of-house PA.

## Spaces for Rent
1. **Main Stage & Concert Hall**
   - Max Capacity: 200 Guests
   - Setup: Tiered standing & modular lounge seating, elevated stage
   - Sound: Line Array active PA system, DMX moving heads, stage wash, artist green room
   - Base Price: From ₹15,000
   - Best For: Indie concerts, album showcases, corporate town halls, live tapings
2. **Acoustic Lounge & Jam Room**
   - Max Capacity: 60 Guests
   - Setup: Intimate circular arrangement, velvet sofa booths, warm tungsten illumination
   - Sound: Shure SM58 vocal mics, studio monitors, Yamaha digital mixer
   - Base Price: From ₹6,000
   - Best For: Candlelight listening sessions, open mics, stand-up comedy, acoustic releases
3. **Creator Workshop Room**
   - Max Capacity: 40 Guests
   - Setup: Modular tables, whiteboard wall, ergonomic chairs
   - Tech: 4K laser projection, gigabit wireless networking, podcast recording gear
   - Base Price: From ₹5,000
   - Best For: Design sprints, creator meetups, masterclasses, listening parties

## Pro Audio Rental Inventory (Koramangala, Bangalore)
- **Yamaha DBR12 Active PA**: 1000W Class-D amplifier, 12" woofer, 131 dB SPL. Ideal for vocals, acoustic sets, and DJ monitoring.
- **Yamaha DBR15 Active PA**: 1000W Class-D amplifier, 15" woofer with extended low-frequency response.
- **Yamaha DXS15mkII Active Subwoofer**: 1020W, 135 dB SPL, bass-reflex design delivering down to 40 Hz punch.
- **Soundcraft Signature 16 Mixer**: 16-channel console featuring Ghost mic preamps, Sapphyre 4-band EQ, and built-in Lexicon studio effects.
- **Yamaha MG12XU Mixer**: 12-channel compact analog mixer with SPX effects processor and 24-bit/192kHz USB interface.
- **Shure SM58 Microphones**: Industry-standard cardioid dynamic vocal microphones with pneumatic shock mounts.
- **Shure Beta 58A Microphones**: Supercardioid vocal mics tailored for high gain-before-feedback.
- **Sennheiser EW 100 G4 Wireless**: UHF wireless handheld and lapel microphone systems.
- **Pioneer DDJ-FLX6-GT & XDJ-RX3**: Club-standard DJ controllers with Rekordbox and Serato DJ Pro integration.
- **Certified Audio Engineer**: On-site sound crew for load-in, soundcheck, and live monitoring.

## Artist Booking Roster
Kesari curates verified Bangalore performers across vocalists, indie bands, instrumentalists, stand-up comedians, and open-mic creators. Booking enquiries are handled directly by Kesari Studio's curation desk to guarantee production quality and transparent scheduling.

## Pure Vegetarian Cafe Menu
- Starters: Truffle Herb Hand-Cut Fries, Paneer Ghee Roast Bruschetta, Crispy Corn & Edamame Croquettes, Charcoal Malai Paneer Skewers
- Mains: Sourdough Burrata Margherita Pizza, Wild Mushroom & Truffle Risotto, Kesari Dal Makhani Pot (slow-cooked 18 hours), Paneer Butter Masala Royale, Kesari Subz Dum Biryani
- Beverages: Single-origin espresso, cold brews, artisanal teas, herbal mocktails
- Event Catering: Bulk packs available for events with 48 hours notice.
